scope: Complete manuscript: every chapter, part introduction, appendix, glossary, evidence table, front matter and bibliography introduction
editorial_rules: Finish each explanation before introducing another concept.
Use ordinary physical language where terminology is avoidable; explain necessary terms before use.
Remove empty rhetorical parallelism and habitual this-not-that framing.
Preserve natural scientific negation when it expresses a necessary limit.
workflow: First author per unit, independent second author on actual drafted output with corrections, director review and preservation gate, single-writer integration.
final_state: Complete: reviewed manuscript integrated, final exports regenerated, build and surface checks passed.

Topology studies properties invariant under continuous deformations
